title: PlanRequest
description: The `request` part of POST /v1/plan. Thumbnails travel as separate multipart parts (see README).

trip_type.description: From the app's trip-type config list, e.g. honeymoon, family, friends, school.

start_date.description: Local date the trip started (YYYY-MM-DD). Lets the title use the month and year without inventing them.

effective_target_s.description: max(target_s, button clips x preset clip_s.min + preset end_card_s). Computed on the phone; see README.

moment_id.description: Also names the clip's thumbnail parts, so it is restricted to filename-safe characters.

t_from_ms.description: Clip start on the trip clock (TRD 5.1). Used for chronological order.

duration_s.description: Length of clips/{moment_id}.mp4. Edit-spec trims must fall inside [0, duration_s].

event_type.description: From Stage 2. Null when the cloud never described the clip (local_fallback, or a button clip whose description failed).

description.description: Stage 2 description, only what is visible. Null under the same conditions as event_type.

score.description: The phone's local score L for ai and local_fallback clips; null for button clips.

proposed_in_s.description: Pre-pass best sub-window start, seconds from the clip file's start.

low_fps_lead_in_s.description: Seconds at the start of the clip file recorded below 30 fps (TRD 4.3). 0 if none. A speed ramp is allowed only inside this lead-in.

thumbnail_count.description: Number of {moment_id}_{k}.jpg parts sent for this clip, k = 0..thumbnail_count-1.
